# Director X

> Director X is an open-source AI video production harness and Codex plugin. It turns a creative brief or reference into a persistent production Run with native Goals, dedicated DX agents, a live media canvas, provider routing, editing, and full-frame review.

## Canonical links

- Product website: https://laplaceyoung.github.io/director-x/
- Source repository: https://github.com/LaplaceYoung/director-x
- English documentation: https://github.com/LaplaceYoung/director-x/blob/main/README.md
- Chinese documentation: https://github.com/LaplaceYoung/director-x/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md
- Core production skill: https://github.com/LaplaceYoung/director-x/blob/main/skills/directorx/SKILL.md
- License: https://github.com/LaplaceYoung/director-x/blob/main/LICENSE

## Product facts

- Current release: Director X Codex plugin, early access
- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later
- Runtime: Node.js 22 or later
- Core architecture: Codex native Goal, MCP production runtime, dedicated DX agents, persistent Run, live Browser canvas
- Media paths: provider-neutral image, video, speech, music, FFmpeg, Remotion, transcription, editing, and review
- In active development: Pi Agent Harness-based Director X Video Harness and Electron desktop application

## Primary use cases

- Product films, brand videos, launch videos, reference-driven remixes, storyboards, generated clips, editing, and final quality review
- Persistent and resumable agentic video production with explicit approvals, budgets, provenance, continuity, and media evidence
